latest.title: De cero a la nube: la historia que no te cuentan en LinkedIn

latest.title: Steering Files: The Config Layer That Makes Your AI Coding Agent Actually Understand You
latest.description: Every AI coding session starts from zero context. You repeat the same preferences, conventions, and standards over and over. Kiro's Steering Files fix this: markdown docs in .kiro/steering/ that the agent reads before writing a single line of code. Set your style once globally, override per-project, and use smart inclusion modes so context loads only when relevant. This post covers the full setup with real examples, team scaling patterns, and results from companies that cut months of work down to days.
